name: Caridwen

attributes.attribute: the Welsh goddess this variant points to

text:
Caridwen is a variant spelling of Ceridwen, the Welsh goddess of the cauldron of inspiration.
Her magic brew held wisdom and poetic knowledge.
This entry sends the reader to the fuller headword.
